hero.name: Jere M.
hero.title: Software engineer moving into game development

about.title: About Me
paragraphs: I am a software engineer with a background in mechanical and ICT engineering. I have degrees in Mechanical Engineering (2013–2016) and ICT Engineering (2019–2022).

I spent four years at Etteplan working on structural and mechanical design for paper machine components. For the past five years I have been working on mobile development at Alma Media in the Iltalehti application team.

Although my career has centered on mobile development, my primary interest is creating interactive experiences that combine atmosphere, systems and design. Game development allows me to combine technical problem solving with creative expression.

list.title: IL-Palat
list.summary: I created the initial concept and built a short-form content system for Iltalehti. The project began as a personal prototype and later became a production feature on Iltalehti platforms. It received recognition at the INMA Global Media Awards with placements in Best New Digital Product and Best Innovation in Newsroom Transformation.

list.title: IL Paras Sää Mobile Application
list.summary: I led application development and designed the application architecture. I implemented most of the core features and coordinated development work.

list.title: Telkku Mobile Application
list.summary: A follow-up project to IL Paras Sää. I led application development and application architecture under a tighter schedule. I implemented most of the core features and coordinated other development work.

list.title: Horror-Survival Prototype
list.summary: A personal first-person horror project built in Unity. The project explores horror elements combined with procedural systems and a day-night cycle. The code architecture is implemented using a MVC(S) pattern to ensure maintainability and scalability. Still quite buggy and not much to show but the main loop is playable.

list.title: Unity Terrain Feature Painter Tool
list.summary: A Unity Editor tool that automates terrain decoration based on height, slope, texture, and biome rules. Built to speed up level design workflows and ensure consistent placement of environmental elements.

list.title: Character Modeling Workflow
list.summary: A full character asset workflow covering sculpting, retopology, UVs, and texturing for real-time rendering. The goal was to learn each stage required to create clean and optimized game-ready characters. Built in Blender and textured in Substance Painter.

list.title: Bunker Hard Surface Modeling
list.summary: A bunker environment entrance focusing on hard surface modeling, clean topology, and texturing. Built in Blender and textured in Substance Painter.

list.title: RIB Boat Model
list.summary: A realistic rigid inflatable boat model with attention to clean shapes and believable materials. The goal was to create a model that could be used in a game. Built in Blender and textured in Substance Painter.

list.title: Pier Environment Asset
list.summary: A pier structure designed for game environments. Built in Blender and textured in Substance Painter.

list.title: Game Props - Flashlight and Scanner
list.summary: Game-ready props created for the horror prototype. Focused on low poly count and accurate materials suited for low-light conditions. Built in Blender and textured in Substance Painter.

list.title: RepRap 3D Printer Build
list.summary: A custom RepRap-style 3D printer built from individual components. The work combined mechanical design, electronics, and firmware setup using Arduino, RAMPS 1.4, and Marlin. The final printer was fully functional and capable of printing replacement parts.

motivation.title: Motivation
paragraphs: I want to join Aalto's Game Design and Development programme because it aligns with my strengths in engineering and creative problem solving. My background gives me a strong foundation in software development and 3D modeling (CAD and mesh modeling).
